body:
I noticed the alleyway where the stray cats lived was unusually clean compared to others in the area. The smell of rotting food had long since disappeared, replaced by the fresh scent of catnip and the chirping of birds from nearby trees. As I walked closer, I saw dozens of hungry stray cats gathered at the edge of the trash cans near the entrance of the depot.

Thoughts raced through my mind as I watched them hungrily eyeing the discarded bread and cheese wrapped in plastic bags. Their coats were filthy, their bodies gaunt. My heart clenched painfully with every sight.
